description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.reason: The application is on legacy .NET Framework and modernization requires a supported runtime baseline for Azure-native evolution.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the application runtime and project format to .NET 10 (latest LTS) while preserving current service behavior and API contracts.

tasks.description: Modernize application integrations to Azure cloud-native services
tasks.reason: The user requested modernization to cloud-native services as part of Azure adoption.
tasks.requirements: Modernize the application to use Azure cloud-native services for data access, runtime identity, and operational logging/telemetry with managed identity-based authentication.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate known CVEs in project dependencies
tasks.reason: Security remediation is mandatory for every modernization plan before deployment.
tasks.requirements: Scan all dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities to patched versions. Document any major upgrade risk and confirm build/test health after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested deploying the modernized application to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the modernized service to Azure Container Apps using managed identity and production-ready configuration.
